answer: Forks twirl above a hollow, so every agent must land a pebble-sized transducer atop an actual knoll. When a fable claims the knoll’s tilt changes, an audit slashes the fabricator’s bond if the tilt deviated more than 0.04 radians. Each Sybil demands a fresh knoll, yet the transducer’s rare crystal lattice cracks under a tenth microsecond delay they can’t clone at scale, ensuring fixed scarcity for every fake.
